sharedImprovements: All 49 states read study context directly from their current harmonized article, including passage-linked native note evidence.
PNG exports retain full selected-date evidence and restore the previous camera after a north-up export.
Search includes existing dated front features, not only formations and operations.
Postwar Volgodonsk, Zheleznogorsk and the Dubna gazetteer point are suppressed across the entire pre-1943 period; no older village location is substituted.
Existing label collision improvements are applied to countries and high-level formations.
